title: French Achilles Tendon Surgery Cohort Study
official: Prospective Cohort Study of Patients Undergoing Surgical Repair of the Achilles Tendon
summary: This 20-year prospective cohort study monitors patients following Achilles tendon repair to assess re-rupture rates, long-term functional outcomes, return-to-sport rates, and procedure-related complications. The aim is to better understand the long-term durability and clinical effectiveness of Achilles tendon repair techniques to optimize patient outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing Achilles tendon repair surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient refusal
